metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2020 · Ratched
metas.description: In 1947, Mildred Ratched begins working as a nurse at a leading psychiatric hospital. But beneath her stylish exterior lurks a growing darkness.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · All the Light We Cannot See
metas.description: The story of Marie-Laure, a blind French teenager, and Werner, a German soldier, whose paths collide in occupied France as both try to survive the devastation of World War II.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · House of Guinness
metas.description: Follows the aftermath of the death of brewery mogul, Sir Benjamin Guinness, and the profound impact of his will on the fate of his four adult children: Arthur, Edward, Anne and Ben.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Trainwreck: Woodstock '99
metas.description: Woodstock 1969 promised peace and music, but its '99 revival delivered days of rage, riots and real harm. Why did it go so horribly wrong?
